items.docs: Report an email address as exhibiting malicious behavior so the EmailRep reputation graph picks up the signal. Requires an API key. Submit one or more `tags` (such as `bec`, `maldoc`, `phishing`, `account_takeover`, `spam`), an optional human-readable `description`, the `timestamp` when the activity was observed (Unix epoch seconds, defaults to now), and an optional `expires` window in hours during which the address should be treated as risky.
